name: Alloy Tether
oneLiner: aUSDT is Alloy by Tether's dollar stablecoin, minted by KYC-verified users depositing Tether Gold (XAUT) into Ethereum vaults at up to 75% LTV.
collateral: Overcollateralized Tether Gold (XAUT) deposited into the Alloy by Tether Ethereum vault; XAUT represents physical gold stored in Swiss vaults
pegMechanism: KYC-verified, whitelisted users mint aUSDT by depositing Ethereum XAUT into Alloy vaults, with positions limited by a 75% maximum mint-to-value ratio. Users return aUSDT to withdraw XAUT collateral, and whitelisted liquidators can repay aUSDT against undercollateralized positions.

genius.issuerEntity: Moon Gold El Salvador, S.A. de C.V. / Moon Gold NA, S.A. de C.V.
genius.notes: aUSDT is treated here as outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin tracking because it is a gold-overcollateralized CDP tethered asset (75% max MTV) rather than an issuer-redeemable payment stablecoin. The GENIUS Act definition requires the issuer to be obligated to redeem at a fixed monetary value backed by permitted reserves; gold (XAUT) is not a permitted reserve asset under GENIUS. Issued by Moon Gold El Salvador, S.A. de C.V. and Moon Gold NA, S.A. de C.V. (Tether subsidiaries), registered with El Salvador's CNAD (EME-0001, EME-0002).

mintAuthority.summary: aUSDT is minted by KYC-verified, whitelisted users depositing XAUT into Tether's CMPVault at up to 75% MTV, but Tether centrally controls the whitelist (PermissionControl), can blacklist/freeze, and administers the upgradeable vault contracts. The EIP-1967 ProxyAdmin for the aUSDT token (0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de) is owned by a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828) with no modules and no guard.

controls.label: Alloy CMPVault (collateral mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint capped at 75% maximum mint-to-value of deposited XAUT collateral per CMP.
controls.evidence: Verified, whitelisted addresses mint aUSDT by depositing XAUT into the CMPVault up to a 75% MTV liquidation point; minting is permissionless only for KYC-passed addresses.

controls.label: Tether PermissionControl whitelist + token admin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200, aUSDT token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot returns 0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de (ProxyAdmin contract). ProxyAdmin owner() returns 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828. getOwners() on that address returns 6 addresses; threshold (dc8452cd) = 3; getModulesPaginated returns empty array; guard slot = 0x0; fallbackHandler slot = 0x0. Confirmed as 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe with no modules.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295200: aUSDT token EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0xd32645695868555918c5c0c8339c71b84c9240de (ProxyAdmin); ProxyAdmin.owner() = 0xc6cde7c39eb2f0f0095f41570af89efc2c1ea828 (Safe); Safe.getOwners() = 6 addresses; Safe threshold = 3; getModulesPaginated = empty; guard = 0x0; fallbackHandler = 0x0. The aUSDT token owner() also returns the same Safe address. KYC-gated CMPVault mint with centralized Safe admin confirmed.

notices.title: Wind-down in progress
notices.message: Tether announced on June 17, 2026 that Alloy by Tether minting is halted and holders should redeem aUSDT by September 17, 2026.

obituary.obituary: Tether began winding down Alloy by Tether and aUSDt on June 17, 2026 after reviewing activity, demand, and product priorities. New positions and minting were closed, while existing users were given until September 17, 2026 to return aUSDt and recover XAUt collateral. The protocol remains available only to unwind existing exposure, so Pharos freezes it as an archived wind-down asset rather than an active issuance venue.
